1.4.field_title: SEIZURE SEMIOLOGY FOR EACH TYPE. Please add a detailed seizure description, from beginning to end, including postictal features.

1.5.field_constraint_data: 1. Clearly generalized seizures, but unable to further classify|1.1. Tonic clonic (in any combination)|1.2. Absence|1.2.1. Typical|1.2.2. Eyelid myoclonia|1.3. Myoclonic|2. Clearly focal seizures, but unable to further classify (Exclude)|2.1. Without impairment of consciousness or responsiveness (Exclude)|2.1.1. With observable motor or autonomic component (roughly corresponds to the concept of "simple partial seizure") (Exclude)|2.1.2. Involving subjective sensory or psychic phenomena only (corresponds to the concept of "aura") (Exclude)|2.2. With impairment of consciousness or responsiveness (roughly corresponds to the concept of "focal seizures with dyscognitive features") (Exclude)|2.3. Evolving to a bilateral, convulsive seizure (involving tonic, clonic, or tonic and clonic components; replaces the term "secondarily generalized seizure") (Exclude)|3. Seizure type is unclassified (Adjudicate)|4. Unconfirmed seizure type (This category should be used for patients with confirmed epilepsy who have some events for which the Primary Investigator does not have >80% certainty that they are seizures.)
